about: Fix or remove a wrong story (README: 'Fix or remove a wrong story'). One line per story inside the [ ] of "list", with a comma between two lines. "story": the story's address, e.g. https://thesimplestnews.com/story/96665c1da439/. Remove it: "remove": true. Or a correction note shown at the top of the story: "note_en" and "note_hi". "date": the day of the fix. Examples: { "story": "https://thesimplestnews.com/story/96665c1da439/", "remove": true, "date": "17 Nov 2026" } and { "story": "https://thesimplestnews.com/story/ec4887e95b7b/", "note_en": "The district is Barabanki, not Lucknow.", "note_hi": "ज़िला बाराबंकी है, लखनऊ नहीं।", "date": "17 Nov 2026" }
